stem: The table shows five data points. A line with equation \(y = 1.2x + c\), where \(c\) is a constant, is fit to the data so that the sum of the residuals of the five data points is 0 (residual = actual value \(-\) predicted value). What is the value of \(c\)?
solution: Sum of residuals \(= \sum y - \sum(1.2x + c) = \sum y - 1.2\sum x - 5c\).
verify:
c = symbols('c')
rows = [(Integer(a), Integer(b)) for a, b in figure['rows']]
sol = solve(Eq(sum(b - (Rational(6, 5)*a + c) for a, b in rows), 0), c)
assert sol == [Rational(21, 5)]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
